messages.subject: Console interface different from the one shown in online manual
parts:
Hi,
I come back to my installation of  Deducer and want to create a plot, but don't get past the installation.
My menu structure has the following main entries:
File - Edit - Workspace - Packages & Data - Windows - Help
I don't have an Analysis and the Plots entry.

How do I get the working installation working ?

TIA
ftr

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Console interface different from the one shown in online manual
parts:
In Packages & Data, go to package manager and select Deducer. If Deducer is not listed there, go to install packages, and install it.

ian
